Message.Name: Outright Market Depth Buy Message
Message.Description: The Buy Market Depth message provides prices and aggregated volumes for each of the best three Buy levels.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of the symbol in the Series Index message

Field.Name: SymbolSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number of messages for the Outright options symbol.

Field.Name: First Level Price
Field.Description: Price of first buy level

Field.Name: Second Level Price
Field.Description: Price of second buy level

Field.Name: Third Level Price
Field.Description: Price of third buy level

Field.Name: First Level Volume
Field.Description: Total volume at first price level

Field.Name: Second Level Volume
Field.Description: Total volume at second price level

Field.Name: Third Level Volume
Field.Description: Total volume at third price level

Field.Name: QuoteCondition
Field.Description: QuoteCondition values

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Filler

Field.Name: First Level Customer Volume*
Field.Description: Total volume of customer orders at the first level

Field.Name: Second Level Customer Volume*
Field.Description: Total volume of customer orders at the second level

Field.Name: Third Level Customer Volume*
Field.Description: Total volume of customer orders at the third level

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Filler

Message.Name: Underlying Index Mapping Message
Message.Description: On system startup, each multicast channel sends all the symbols on its channel. Underlying Index Mapping messages are published first, followed by all Series Index Mapping messages, and for the Complex feed, Complex Symbol Definitions last of all.

Field.Name: UnderlyingIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this underlying symbol in this market. This ID cannot be used to cross reference a security between markets.

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: Full symbol in NYSE Symbology.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: Multicast channel ID of the symbols being provided.

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: Identifies originating market

Field.Name: System ID
Field.Description: ID of the Originating System

Field.Name: Exchange Code
Field.Description: Exchanges where it is listed

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Price Scale Code for price conversion of the symbol. See Price Formats.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Type of Security

Field.Name: Price Resolution
Field.Description: Price Resolution value

Field.Name: Reserved 1
Field.Description: Filler

Message.Name: Series Index Mapping Message
Message.Description: On system startup, each multicast channel sends all the symbols on its channel. Underlying Index Mapping messages are published first, followed by all Series Index Mapping messages, and for the Complex feed, Complex Symbol Definitions last of all.

Field.Name: SeriesIndex
Field.Description: The unique ID of this series in this stream. This ID cannot be used to cross reference a security between markets.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: Multicast channel ID of the symbols being provided.

Field.Name: ReservedA 1
Field.Description: Filler

Field.Name: MarketID
Field.Description: Identifies originating market

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: Identifies Trading unit (TU)

Field.Name: ReservedB 1
Field.Description: Filler

Field.Name: StreamID
Field.Description: Identifies Stream on which this symbol will be updated

Field.Name: UnderlyingIndex
Field.Description: Underlying Stock Mapping Index

Field.Name: ContractMultiplier
Field.Description: Contract quantity

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: YY MM DD

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Put or Call

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price. ASCII 0-9 with optional decimal point. EG: 51.75, 123

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Decimal places on price

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: Full underlying symbol in NYSE Symbology

Field.Name: OptionSymbolRoot
Field.Description: OCC root of option symbol

Field.Name: GroupID
Field.Description: Used by Market Makers. Predefined group of series within a given underlying symbol.

Message.Name: Stream ID Message
Message.Description: In all multicast channels, a Stream ID Message is sent immediately after each packet header to uniquely identify the source or Stream ID of the data in the packet.

Field.Name: StreamID
Field.Description: Represents the Stream ID for this packet update. The Stream ID represents a unique source (specific thread within a publisher task).

Field.Name: Reserved 2
Field.Description: Filler

Message.Name: Sequence Number Reset Message
Message.Description: This message is sent to reset the Message Sequence Number at start of day, or in response to failures.

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: The time when this msg was generated in the order book, in seconds since Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC.

Field.Name: SourceTimeNS
Field.Description: The nanosecond offset from the SourceTime

Field.Name: ProductID
Field.Description: The unique ID for this NYSE feed listed in the feed’s client specification.

Field.Name: ChannelID
Field.Description: The ID of the multicast channel over which the packet was sent.

Enum.Name: MarketImbalanceSide
Enum.Description: Side of the market imbalance Buy/sell

Enum.Name: Capacity
Enum.Description: Customer or Firm capacity specified with the order.
